special_message.title: A Little Reminder
special_message.text: Whatever this week brings, remember how proud I am of you. You are doing amazing!

cheer_messages.title: Mid-Week Recharge
cheer_messages.text: Fiker Berchilegn eshi hiwote! Today is completely free from classes. Take a slow morning, enjoy your coffee, and rest up. You have been working so hard, and you truly deserve this day off.

cheer_messages.title: Yene Anbesa
cheer_messages.text: Yene Anbesa weded new maregesh.... No schedules to rush to, no classrooms to walk to today. Take this time to do whatever makes you happiest. Empwa!

cheer_messages.title: We Are Blessed
cheer_messages.text: We are blessed betam ena thank you jesus. Rest is just as important as hard work, yene mist. Relax your mind, take good care of yourself today, and know that you are deeply loved.

cheer_messages.title: Look Where You Are Now
cheer_messages.text: I told you JC yechelal beye... look where you are now my strong wife. You got this belaaaaaa! Enjoy your studio break today.
